title: Filtered cover core assertion transfer
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure], $X$ a reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] separated finite-type $k$-curve of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], $j:U\to X$ an open immersion, $r$ a prime, $R=\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbb Z/r\mathbb Z)$, and $G$ a finite locally constant $R$-module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] on $U$. Let $v:V\to U$ be finite etale. Suppose $v^*G$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] has a specified finite filtration $W_0=0$, $W_n\cong v^*G$, with monic inclusions $W_i\to W_{i+1}$ for $i<n$ and each cokernel the constant $R$-module sheaf $R$ on $V$. Assume all eight assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] for extension by zero of constant $R$ from every open in every reduced separated finite-type $k$-curve of dimension at most one. Then all eight assertions hold for $j_!(v_*v^*G)$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].

proof.text: Obtain the reduced finite compactification and cartesian square; install the supplied curve, reducedness, finite and open-immersion hypotheses.
Apply hconstant on this compactification and obtain zero and successor assertion steps. Natural-number induction for i<=n gives assertions for a_! W_n.
Unpack the supplied terminal isomorphism and apply prime-module finite-open transfer to a_! W_n. This gives exactly the core conclusion, with no retract argument.

proof_origin: Stacks 03SD route: reduced cartesian compactification; explicit Lean induction from zero/successor devissage; finite-open assertion transfer with terminal isomorphism. R1 2026-10-12.

    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime]
    (G : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))))
    [Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G] (v : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite v] [Etale v]
    (n : ℕ)
    (W : ℕ → Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))))
    (ι : ∀ i, W i ⟶ W (i + 1)) (hzero : IsZero (W 0))
    (hend : Nonempty (W n ≅
      (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) v).obj G))
    (hquot : ∀ i < n, Mono (ι i) ∧ Nonempty (cokernel (ι i) ≅
      (constantSheaf V.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))).obj
        (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))))
    (hconstant : ∀ {Y T : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve g] [IsReduced Y]
      (a : T ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion a],
      IsCurve.Assertions (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)) g
        ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) a).obj
          ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))).obj
            (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))))) :
    IsCurve.Assertions (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)) f
      ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) j).obj
        ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) v).obj
          ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) v).obj G)))
